name: dsul Context
description: Cache-backed dsul task/habit/project context injected into every OpenClaw prompt. Subscribes to dsul change webhooks for zero-latency freshness.

dsulUrl.description: Base URL of your dsul deployment (e.g. https://dsul.yourdomain.com)

apiKey.description: Your personal dsul API key. `openclaw dsul-context setup` fills it in after you authorize at dsul's /connect page.

publicUrl.description: Your gateway's public URL (e.g. https://your-machine.ts.net) — registers …/plugins/dsul/chat with dsul for sidebar chat

agentId.description: OpenClaw agent id for dsul sidebar chat (default: main)

id.description: Optional alias for agent id if agentId is not set

webhookSecret.description: Optional HMAC secret for verifying change event payloads

cacheTtlMs.description: Max cache age before forcing a re-fetch (default: 300000ms = 5 min)
